entry.intent: Enter or resume the repository without broad archaeology
entry.success: The active unit, owner, promotion boundary, and direct gate are known

implementation.success: The consumer reaches the change and the named gate remains truthful

failure.intent: Diagnose a false-success smell or regression
failure.success: The actual mechanism is corrected without hiding the physical gate

promotion.intent: Move a candidate concept into the live runtime
promotion.success: The actual consumer reaches one owner and no unpromoted import enters boot
